newsitem.title: USA: Security Associates gets $15 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Security Associates gets $15 mln credit.

text.p: Security Associates International Inc said Monday it secured a $15 million line of credit with FINOVA Capital Corp, a middle market lender specializing in the radio and cellular industries.
The credit will be used to pay debt, acquire alarm monitoring central stations and subscribers and for general corporate purposes.
Security Associates operates a dealer network providing more than 2,000 alarm dealers with education, training, financing and brokerage services.
